## ChatOSS v1.21.0

### New plan tiers: Max + BYOK

- **Max** ($100/mo, $90 usage cap) joins Plus as a cloud tier.
- **BYOK** ($39/yr) — bring your own API keys. A one-time $79 lifetime BYOK unlock is also available (per account, up to 3 devices).
- The desktop now understands the new tier ids and maps legacy plans (starter → plus, pro/ultra → max) so existing subscribers keep their access.
- The app registers its device id with your account so lifetime unlocks can be enforced across your 3 devices.

### BYOK-aware UI

- Settings → Usage shows "BYOK plan — no cloud usage" instead of the usage bar.
- The cloud-usage popovers and the account sheet treat BYOK as a paid plan with intentionally-locked cloud models — no misleading upgrade prompts, accurate renewal/cloud-model labels.

### Also in this release

- Monitor surface: subscribe + wait label + cancel tool handlers and pane row (from v1.20.2 work, shipped with this tag).

**macOS users**: this is a universal build (Apple silicon + Intel), notarized and stapled.
